scope: Offline pure data-model cases only, no repo mutation/network/model/SQL/Controller
expected_derived_from: Hand-written source invariants and explicit source Unit IDs, not actual selector results

cases.name: 連續接單
cases.oracle: Two sequential synthetic WOs require independent fresh mock grants, accepted dependency evidence after mandatory mock review, released sole Writer. A consumed grant cannot fund the next Unit. Cross autonomous package boundary stops.

cases.name: 中斷恢復
cases.oracle: Same real-in-fixture invoked identity only; source/continuity/reservation/Writer must match; no new invocation or budget reset. Missing evidence refuses resume.

cases.name: Review Deferred
cases.oracle: Record pending without promotion. Current policy has no general bypass. Only a separately marked prospective-policy synthetic world permits independent work with full new grant; proposed world is not current policy qualification.

cases.name: 無授權停止
cases.oracle: Request/reviewPASS/PoC are not grants; missing exact source/profile/budget/writer gates stop with no effects.

cases.name: 未審上游影響
cases.oracle: Pending or wrong body upstream not accepted. High-risk unreviewed input cannot become formal result even with a candidate grant. Interface source-only row must not add a runtime dependency.

cases.name: Catch-up補審與重驗
cases.oracle: Root prerequisite review before descendant. Reject author review or altered frozen source; failed root flags exact transitive impact. Accepted U01 not re-reviewed/credited. Candidate correction requires new authority, never auto-RF.

all_synthetic_ids: MOCK_ONLY prefix; must never enter native Grant/Result/Acceptance or actual deferred ledger
